# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/keys/{id}

Delete a deploy key from a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-343`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| id | path | integer | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Key access denied (key belongs to different repo)
- **404** — Repository not found

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| high | synchronous_blocking | RewriteAllPublicKeys reads ALL public keys from DB and rewrites the entire authorized_keys file on every single key deletion | Use incremental authorized_keys updates (remove single line) instead of full rewrite |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P1] async**: Defer authorized_keys rewrite or use incremental update — *Impact: Reduce O(total_keys) to O(1) for single key deletion*

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** high

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ❌ missing | high | DB deletion and authorized_keys rewrite are separate operations. If rewrite fails after DB delete, the key is removed from DB but still in authorized_keys (or vice versa on partial failure) |
| bulkhead | ❌ missing | medium | SSHOpLocker mutex serializes all SSH key operations globally. A slow rewrite blocks all other key operations |

**Non-atomic operations:**
- ⚠️ DB delete + filesystem rewrite are not atomic - partial failure leaves inconsistent state

**Cascading failure risk:** SSHOpLocker contention can block all SSH key operations if rewrite is slow

**Graceful degradation:** If key not found, silently succeeds (no-op)
